asA: shelf consumer whose Worker refuses cheap submit-without-token attempts at the earliest possible boundary
iWant: the guard to reject every submit whose payload has no Cf-Turnstile-Response field with 400 before the downstream handler is entered
soThat: downstream handlers never execute against a missing-token submit
title: T-5 refuse-if-token-missing guard: a submit without Cf-Turnstile-Response rejects with 400 before any downstream logic

acceptanceCriteria.description: A source-tree scan of the pack fixture (guard-shape-scan) enumerates every elicited surface and asserts each carries a token-required guard registered at the route level. A live POST to /api/submit without a Cf-Turnstile-Response field is rejected with 400 and no downstream handler side-effect is observable. Refusal body carries a stable error-code, not the sitekey.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running with every elicited surface registered
acceptanceCriteria.when: a submit reaches the route without a Cf-Turnstile-Response value
acceptanceCriteria.then: the guard rejects with 400 with an error-code body and no downstream handler runs
